heading: Remote backups, split local panes, and remembered conflict choices
summary: Back up remote files with one click, split the local file browser, and stop answering the same overwrite question. Agent settings are also simpler.
changes: Right-click a remote file or folder and choose Backup to make a dated copy next to it, keeping permissions and times.
Split the local file browser into two panes and drop downloads on either one. The split is saved with workspaces.
Apply one answer to a whole transfer, remember it for later, or replace only newer files. Reset it in Settings → General.
Bookmarks are listed with their access status, access survives renames, and the Maximum preset no longer asks before each command.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
